notes:
Based on the Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's own pages, here are two real toddler programs running in the Sept–Dec window:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Toddler Gym, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs",
      "when": "Fall Session: Sept 10 - Dec 16 (no classes Oct 10)",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool Drop-In, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "Preschool aged child (under 4), with parent",
      "when": "Thursdays 9:30am-12:00pm, Oct 9 to June 26 (no drop-in outside these dates)",
      "price": "$15, one parent/up to 4 children",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what I found: 
The Toddler Gym class is for 18 months to 3 years, involves parent participation led by a coach through warm-up, games, music and circuits on gymnastic events, and runs 30 minutes
, with 
the Fall Session running Sept 10 - Dec 16, with no classes Oct 10
. Registration-open dates varied confusingly across the site's own pages (some pages showed February, others July), so I've left that detail out rather than guess.

For the drop-in, 
it's for a busy preschool aged child under 4, and parents stay with their child while they explore the gymnastics equipment
, with 
the day and time listed as Thursdays 9:30 am - 12:00pm
, 
running October 9 till June 26, 2026, with no drop-in outside those dates or during March Break and Statutory Holidays
, and 
costing $15 for one parent and up to 4 children, with no pre-registration necessary and payment made in person
.
